subject: french
title: Grade 6 French — Set 2
description: Verbs, articles, questions, and everyday expressions

questions.question: What does 'j\'aime' mean?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime' means 'I like' or 'I love'. It comes from the verb 'aimer' (to like/love).

questions.question: How do you say 'the book' (masculine) in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le' is the masculine definite article. 'Le livre' = the book. 'La' is feminine.

questions.question: Which verb means 'to eat' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Manger' means to eat. 'Boire' = to drink, 'parler' = to speak, 'aller' = to go.

questions.question: What does 'Comment t\'appelles-tu?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Comment t'appelles-tu?' literally means 'What do you call yourself?' = What is your name?

questions.question: How many days are in 'une semaine' (a week)?
questions.explanation: 'Une semaine' means one week = 7 days. The 7 days: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche.
